title: Authorization-Related Chargebacks
short_description: Used when an error occurred in requesting authorization for a transaction, such as missing authorization, expired protection period, or multiple requests.
source_citation: Mastercard Reason Codes: Complete 2026 Dispute Code List - Authorization-Related Chargebacks

title: Point-of-Interaction Error Chargebacks
short_description: Applies to errors made when processing a transaction, including duplicate debits, incorrect amounts, currency errors, or late presentment.
source_citation: Mastercard Reason Codes: Complete 2026 Dispute Code List - Point-of-Interaction Error Chargebacks

title: Cardholder Dispute
short_description: Catch-all consumer dispute code covering non-receipt, cancelled recurring transactions, defective or not-as-described goods, credit not processed, and quality complaints. Winning evidence depends on the specific sub-reason cited.
source_citation: Chargebacks911, Mastercard reason code 4853 (Cardholder Dispute)

title: No Cardholder Authorization
short_description: Issued when the cardholder claims they did not authorize or participate in the transaction.
source_citation: Mastercard Reason Codes: Complete 2026 Dispute Code List - Fraud-Related Chargeback

title: Questionable Merchant Activity
short_description: Raised when an acquirer or network flags the transaction due to potential fraudulent or suspicious merchant behavior.
source_citation: Mastercard Reason Codes: Complete 2026 Dispute Code List - Fraud-Related Chargeback

title: Chip Liability Shift
short_description: Occurs when a fraudulent EMV transaction was processed at a non-EMV compliant terminal, shifting liability to the merchant.
source_citation: Mastercard Reason Codes: Complete 2026 Dispute Code List - Fraud-Related Chargeback

title: Chip Liability Shift — Lost/Stolen/Never Received Issue (NRI) Fraud
short_description: Applies when a lost, stolen, or NRI card was fraudulently used at a terminal that did not support EMV PIN verification.
source_citation: Mastercard Reason Codes: Complete 2026 Dispute Code List - Fraud-Related Chargeback

title: Installment Billing Dispute
short_description: Raised when the cardholder disputes an installment transaction charge or terms.
source_citation: Mastercard Reason Codes: Complete 2026 Dispute Code List - Miscellaneous Chargebacks

title: Cardholder Dispute Not Classified Elsewhere (US)
short_description: Used in the US region for general cardholder disputes that do not fit into other specific categories.
source_citation: Mastercard Reason Codes: Complete 2026 Dispute Code List - Miscellaneous Chargebacks

title: Warning Bulletin File
short_description: Legacy reason code previously used when a transaction was completed despite being listed on an authorization warning bulletin.
source_citation: Mastercard Reason Codes: Complete 2026 Dispute Code List - Legacy Reason Codes

title: Account Number Not on File
short_description: Legacy reason code used when an authorization attempt involved an account number that did not exist on the issuer file.
source_citation: Mastercard Reason Codes: Complete 2026 Dispute Code List - Legacy Reason Codes

title: No Show / Addendum Dispute
short_description: Legacy reason code for disputes related to hotel no-show charges or addendum fees.
source_citation: Mastercard Reason Codes: Complete 2026 Dispute Code List - Legacy Reason Codes

title: Credit Not Processed
short_description: Legacy reason code used when a merchant agreed to process a refund or credit but failed to do so.
source_citation: Mastercard Reason Codes: Complete 2026 Dispute Code List - Legacy Reason Codes

title: Goods or Services Not Provided
short_description: Cardholder claims they paid for goods or services but never received them. Applies to physical goods, digital deliverables, and services.
source_citation: Chargebacks911, Mastercard reason code 4855 (Goods or Services Not Provided)

title: Transaction Amount Differs / Paid by Other Means
short_description: Legacy reason code used when the billed amount differed from the authorized amount or was settled via another payment method.
source_citation: Mastercard Reason Codes: Complete 2026 Dispute Code List - Legacy Reason Codes

title: Correct Transaction Currency Not Provided
short_description: Legacy reason code used when a transaction was processed in an unapproved or incorrect currency.
source_citation: Mastercard Reason Codes: Complete 2026 Dispute Code List - Legacy Reason Codes

title: Cancelled Recurring / Digital Goods
short_description: Legacy reason code applied to unauthorized recurring transaction charges after cancellation or digital goods issues.
source_citation: Mastercard Reason Codes: Complete 2026 Dispute Code List - Legacy Reason Codes

title: Late Presentment
short_description: Legacy reason code used when a transaction was submitted for clearing outside the permitted timeframe.
source_citation: Mastercard Reason Codes: Complete 2026 Dispute Code List - Legacy Reason Codes

title: EMV Liability Shift Counterfeit Fraud
short_description: Applies when a counterfeit card transaction was processed at a non-EMV compliant terminal.
source_citation: Visa Reason Codes List, Fraud section: 10.1

title: EMV Liability Shift Non-Counterfeit Fraud
short_description: Applies to lost or stolen card fraud executed at a terminal that is not EMV compliant.
source_citation: Visa Reason Codes List, Fraud section: 10.2

title: Other Fraud — Card-Present Environment
short_description: Covers fraudulent card-present transactions where EMV liability shift does not apply.
source_citation: Visa Reason Codes List, Fraud section: 10.3

title: Other Fraud — Card-Absent Environment
short_description: Cardholder claims they did not authorize a transaction that took place in a card-not-present environment (online, phone, mail order). The most common Visa fraud reason code for e-commerce disputes.
source_citation: Chargebacks911, Visa reason code 10.4 (Other Fraud, Card-Absent Environment)

title: Visa Fraud Monitoring Program
short_description: Identifies transactions disputed under Visa fraud monitoring threshold programs.
source_citation: Visa Reason Codes List, Fraud section: 10.5

title: Card Recovery Bulletin
short_description: Transaction was processed on a card listed in the Card Recovery Bulletin.
source_citation: Visa Reason Codes List, Authorization Errors section: 11.1

title: Declined Authorization
short_description: Merchant processed a transaction despite receiving a declined authorization response.
source_citation: Visa Reason Codes List, Authorization Errors section: 11.2

title: No Authorization/Late Presentment
short_description: Transaction was settled without prior authorization or presented outside required timeframes.
source_citation: Visa Reason Codes List, Authorization Errors section: 11.3

title: Incorrect Transaction Code
short_description: The transaction was processed with an invalid or improper transaction code.
source_citation: Visa Reason Codes List, Processing Errors section: 12.2

title: Incorrect Currency
short_description: The transaction currency transmitted differs from the currency agreed upon.
source_citation: Visa Reason Codes List, Processing Errors section: 12.3

title: Incorrect Account Number
short_description: The transaction was processed using an incorrect account number.
source_citation: Visa Reason Codes List, Processing Errors section: 12.4

title: Incorrect Amount
short_description: The processed transaction amount differs from the agreed or authorized amount.
source_citation: Visa Reason Codes List, Processing Errors section: 12.5

title: Duplicate Processing
short_description: A single transaction was processed and submitted multiple times.
source_citation: Visa Reason Codes List, Processing Errors section: 12.6.1

title: Paid by Other Means
short_description: Cardholder paid for the transaction using another payment method but was billed on this card.
source_citation: Visa Reason Codes List, Processing Errors section: 12.6.2

title: Invalid Data
short_description: Transaction data contained invalid or corrupted information.
source_citation: Visa Reason Codes List, Processing Errors section: 12.7

title: Merchandise/Services Not Received
short_description: Cardholder claims goods or services were paid for but not received by the agreed-upon delivery date. Applies to physical goods, digital deliverables, and rendered services.
source_citation: Chargebacks911, Visa reason code 13.1 (Merchandise/Services Not Received)

title: Canceled Recurring Transaction
short_description: Cardholder claims a recurring payment was billed after a cancellation request.
source_citation: Visa Reason Codes List, Customer Disputes section: 13.2

title: Not as Described or Defective Merchandise / Services
short_description: Cardholder claims goods or services were defective, damaged, or not as advertised.
source_citation: Visa Reason Codes List, Customer Disputes section: 13.3

title: Counterfeit Merchandise
short_description: Cardholder claims merchandise purchased is counterfeit or fake.
source_citation: Visa Reason Codes List, Customer Disputes section: 13.4

title: Misrepresentation
short_description: Cardholder claims terms of sale or quality of goods/services were misrepresented.
source_citation: Visa Reason Codes List, Customer Disputes section: 13.5

title: Credit Not Processed
short_description: Cardholder was promised a credit or refund that was not posted to the account.
source_citation: Visa Reason Codes List, Customer Disputes section: 13.6

title: Cancelled Merchandise / Services
short_description: Cardholder canceled merchandise or services per policy, but was still charged.
source_citation: Visa Reason Codes List, Customer Disputes section: 13.7

title: Original Credit Transaction Not Accepted
short_description: Cardholder's bank did not accept an Original Credit Transaction (OCT).
source_citation: Visa Reason Codes List, Customer Disputes section: 13.8

title: Non-Receipt of Cash at an ATM
short_description: Cardholder attempted cash withdrawal at an ATM or load transaction, but did not receive funds.
source_citation: Visa Reason Codes List, Customer Disputes section: 13.9
